real_evaluation.metric: Unchanged center translation cm; full physical C2 rotation degrees; corner8 SQPnP+LM.
real_evaluation.natural_joint_medians: All3 seeds strictly lower T and R than shared R0_ONLY, paired original DIVERSE251, R0, PRIOR1 and FULL125.
real_evaluation.uncertainty: 2000 crossed paired recording/seed bootstrap, seed20261001; upper95<0 for both T/R versus shared R0_ONLY and R0.
real_evaluation.recording_sensitivity: Leave each natural recording out: both mean-seed medians lower versus shared R0_ONLY and R0.
real_evaluation.natural_tail: Mean-seed T/R P90<=1.05 versus shared R0_ONLY and R0; no seed increases failures.
real_evaluation.clean: Mean-seed T/R median and P90<=1.05 R0; no seed increases failures.
real_evaluation.wood: All45 retained as separate form-transfer stress, no selection or dropped seed.
real_evaluation.historical_gate_parity: Same original stability gate structure and tolerances; R0_ONLY is this intervention matched control. No old trained coordinate outputs are changed.
real_evaluation.limitations: Repeated DEV and source VAL exposure via frozen refiner; not new independent TEST. Passing alone does not prove unseen-recording generalization.

original_goal_criteria.all_three_seeds_joint_gain: DIVERSE251 each seed has smaller natural99 T and R medians than pairedSINGLE251 and fixedR0/PRIOR1/FULL125. No best-seed reporting.
original_goal_criteria.joint_uncertainty: For DIVERSE-SINGLE and DIVERSE-R0, paired recording-and-training-seed bootstrap2000/seed20261001 of mean per-seed population medians has upper95% endpoint<0 for BOTH T and R.
original_goal_criteria.recording_sensitivity: Leaving out each of6naturalrecordings retains negative mean-seed median differences for BOTH metrics versus R0 and pairedSINGLE.
original_goal_criteria.natural_tails: Mean acrossseed P90 T/R no more than5% above R0 and pairedSINGLE. Full pose failure count must not increase.
original_goal_criteria.clean_preservation: Mean acrossseed clean29 median and P90 T/R no more than5% aboveR0; pose failure count notincrease.
original_goal_criteria.tolerance_status: The5% guards are provisional engineering non-regression limits, not an empirical noise floor/MDE or evidence of statistical equivalence.
original_goal_criteria.strong_generalization: Not claimed from reusedDEV,3seeds and6recordings. Independent new-recording confirmation remains a separate evidentiary limitation.

original_goal_contract_correction: Previous unused learned-real evaluators omitted explicit SINGLE251 comparisons. No learned real results were produced by those failed-source methods. Restore the original goal checks before sealing this experiment, with no change to source45 gates or learning.
training_margin_scope: TRAIN-only log1p normalized anchor excess changes fitting loss. Only risk/margin SHA strings are verified here; no margin values are loaded or created for real selection.
runtime_selection: Unadjusted learned score over every original valid whole-pose candidate; no risk margin, reference-based filter, or changed tie rule.
feature_order: Normalize raw94 in float32; promote to float64; concatenate z94, abs(z-z_R0_GEO)94, candidate-identity1; no extra normalization.
anchor_rule: Frozen input-only R0 operational GEO; never learned R0_ONLY or a reference-selected pose.
missing_anchor_rule: All-invalid rows require anchor=-1 and zero context; any valid candidate without a valid R0 GEO anchor is a contract error.
feature_validity: Original frame-valid broadcast to2, intersect cached per-hypothesis pose availability.
seed_meaning: Three frozen refiner seeds; R0_ONLY fitted once and repeated as a shared control, not three independent fits.
